description: Add a getProviderName() function to src/llm.js that returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string

contract.raw_request: Add a getProviderName() function to src/llm.js that returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string
contract.goal: Add a function getProviderName() to src/llm.js that returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string. This will allow developers to programmatically retrieve the active provider name without hardcoding it.
required_behavior: Add the function getProviderName() to src/llm.js
Return a string containing the currently active LLM provider name
Ensure the function correctly returns the provider name
constraints: Do not modify the existing provider configuration
Do not expose the provider name through other means
Do not call this function from other parts of the code unless intended

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The getProviderName() function exists in src/llm.js
The function returns the currently active provider name

verification_plan: Verify the existence of getProviderName() in src/llm.js
Check that the function returns a string
Test that the function returns the correct provider name
